description: This file defines an interface IHealthCheckable in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which specifies a method for checking the health status of a service or component.

classes.name: IHealthCheckable
classes.description: An interface for services that can be probed for health status, providing a method to check health and return a boolean indicating health status along with a reason.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Method to determine the health of the instance, returning true if healthy and false otherwise, with an out parameter providing the reason if unhealthy.
